```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(tictoc)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(mitml)
library(miceadds)
library(emmeans)
library(mitools)
library(ggplot2)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r load data}

bas_rresp <- readRDS("Data/bas.Rds")
class(bas_rresp) <- "mitml.list"

```


### BAS Reward Responsiveness - Age/adversity interactions ###

### DEPRIVATION ###

# Lack of supervision

```{r}

model_null <- with(bas_rresp, lmer
  (rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id), control = lmerControl(
   optimizer = "bobyqa",
   optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
   )))

model_alt <- with(bas_rresp, lmer(
  rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + lack_supervision*age + lack_supervision*age_sq + 
    primary_cg_lack_supp + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id),
  control = lmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
  )
))

lack_supervision_interaction <- testModels(model_alt, model_null, method = "D1")

lack_supervision_interaction

saveRDS(lack_supervision_interaction, file = "Results/behavioral/age_interaction/lack_supervision_d1.Rds") 

lack_supervision_interaction <- readRDS("Results/behavioral/age_interaction/lack_supervision_d1.Rds")

lack_supervision_interaction
testEstimates(model_alt, extra.pars = TRUE)
est <- testEstimates(model_alt, extra.pars = TRUE)
confint(est)  
```

### Linear combination of beta coefficients (using emtrends) ###

## Lack supervision

```{r}


fit_model <- function(df) {
  
  model <- lmer(
   rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + lack_supervision*age + lack_supervision*age_sq + 
    primary_cg_lack_supp + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id),
  data = df,
  control = lmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
  )
)

  
  return(model)
}




modlist <- lapply(bas_rresp, fit_model) 

pooled <- modlist %>% as.mira() %>% pool()

results_tidy <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled, conf.int = TRUE)

saveRDS(modlist, file = "Results/behavioral/age_interaction/lack_supervision_age_model.Rds") 

```


```{r}

modlist <- readRDS("Results/behavioral/age_interaction/lack_supervision_age_model.Rds") 

get_emtrends <- function(model) {
  emtrends(model, ~ age, var = "lack_supervision", at = list(age = c(0, 2, 4), age_sq = c(0, 4, 16))) %>% as.data.frame()
}


clean_emtrends <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename(estimate = lack_supervision.trend, SE = SE) %>%
    select(age, estimate, SE)
}

emtrends_list <- lapply(modlist, get_emtrends)
emtrends_list_clean <- lapply(emtrends_list, clean_emtrends)

pool_emtrends_at_age <- function(emtrends_list, target_age) {
  est_se <- lapply(emtrends_list, function(df) {
    row <- df[df$age == target_age, ]
    if (nrow(row) != 1) stop(paste("Problem with age:", target_age))
    list(est = row$estimate, se = row$SE)
  })

  estimates <- sapply(est_se, `[[`, "est")
  ses <- sapply(est_se, `[[`, "se")

  pooled <- pool.scalar(Q = estimates, U = ses^2)

  # Critical t-value for 95% CI
  t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = pooled$df)

  # Compute confidence intervals
  lower_ci <- pooled$qbar - t_crit * sqrt(pooled$t)
  upper_ci <- pooled$qbar + t_crit * sqrt(pooled$t)

  data.frame(
    age = target_age,
    estimate = pooled$qbar,
    std.error = sqrt(pooled$t),
    df = pooled$df,
    p.value = 2 * pt(abs(pooled$qbar / sqrt(pooled$t)), df = pooled$df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    ci.lower = lower_ci,
    ci.upper = upper_ci
  )
}


# apply across ages
ages <- c(0, 2, 4)
pooled_age <- bind_rows(
  lapply(ages, function(a) pool_emtrends_at_age(emtrends_list_clean, a))
)

saveRDS(pooled_age, file = "Results/behavioral/age_interaction/lack_supervision_age_emtrends.Rds") 

```

Plot

```{r}

plot <- ggplot(pooled_age, aes(x = age, y = estimate)) +
  geom_line(color = "navy", size = 1) +              
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +              
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci.lower, ymax = ci.upper), 
                width = 0.2,                             
                color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4),
                     labels = c("9/10", "11/12", "13/14")) +      
  labs(
    title = str_wrap("Effect of age 9/10 lack of supervison on BAS Reward Responsiveness with Age", width = 40),
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Pooled Estimate (95% CI)"
  ) +
   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40", size = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +                         # Clean minimal theme with bigger base font
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),  # Center and bold title
    axis.title = element_text()
  )


plot <- ggplot(pooled_age, aes(x = age, y = estimate)) +
  geom_line(color = "navy", size = 1) +              
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +              
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci.lower, ymax = ci.upper), 
                width = 0.2,

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4),
                     labels = c("9/10", "11/12", "13/14")) +      
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +   # <- Set same limits for all plots
  labs(
    title = str_wrap("Effect of age 9/10 lack of supervision on BAS Reward Responsiveness with Age", width = 40),
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Pooled Estimate (95% CI)"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40", size = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text()

plot

ggsave("Plots/lack_supervision_age_emtrends.Rds.svg", , plot = plot, width = 7, height = 7, device = svglite::svglite)

```
